# Henleaze Tax Consultancy

> Henleaze Tax Consultancy is a Bristol-based accountancy firm providing fixed-fee tax and accounting services for contractors, freelancers, landlords, small businesses, and limited companies across Bristol and the UK. Trusted since 2009, HMRC registered, and fully compliant.

Henleaze Tax Consultancy helps clients stay compliant and tax-efficient through proactive advice rather than just standard compliance work. Services are delivered both remotely and in person, with transparent fixed-fee pricing and no hidden charges.

Contact: +44 7949 956279 | info@henleazetaxconsultancy.com
Address: CEED House, 97-107 Wilder Street, St Pauls, Bristol, England, BS2 8QU

## Services

- [Contractor Accounting](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/contractor-accountants): IR35 support, company formation, salary-dividend optimisation, and tax-efficient planning for contractors and freelancers.
- [Small Business Accounting](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/small-business-accountants): Bookkeeping, VAT returns, year-end accounts, and business advisory for small and growing businesses.
- [Landlord Services](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/landlord-accountants): Rental income tax, capital gains, portfolio structuring, and expense tracking for landlords and property investors.
- [Payroll & HR Services](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/payroll-and-hr-services): Monthly payroll, RTI submissions, pension auto-enrolment, payslips, P60s, and P45s.
- [Tax Planning](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/tax-planning): Corporation Tax, Capital Gains Tax, Inheritance Tax, and long-term strategic tax planning.
- [Outsourced Accounting](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/outsourced-accounting-services): Dedicated accountant support, bookkeeping, reporting, and payroll management as an outsourced finance function.
- [VAT & Bookkeeping](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/vat-and-bookkeeping-accounting-services): VAT returns, Dext/Xero support, bank reconciliation, and Making Tax Digital (MTD) compliance.
- [Company Secretarial Services](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/company-secretarial-services): Registered office services, confirmation statements, share management, and statutory registers.
- [R&D Tax Credit Claims](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/rd-tax-credit-claim): Technical report preparation, cost identification, and HMRC submission support for R&D tax relief claims.
- [Personal Tax & Self Assessment](https://henleazetaxconsultancy.com/services/personal-tax-and-self-assessment-service): Self Assessment returns, rental and investment income reporting, and tax planning and optimisation.
